description: Self-hosted in .github/workflows/renovate.yaml, PR mode. Merging a chart PR publishes that chart's release, so a PR here is never automerged and never carries more than one chart.

Renovate cannot bump a chart's own version:, and chart-releaser publishes nothing without it. Whoever takes a Renovate PR adds that commit by hand; the push is also what runs Helm CI, which GitHub does not start for a PR opened with GITHUB_TOKEN.

Only the custom regex manager runs. github-actions pins stay with Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml) so the two bots cannot open the same PR, and the native helm managers would reach the charts' subchart dependencies and the 10 charts tracking tag: latest, neither of which this covers.

Both limits are 2: at most two open Renovate PRs, and one weekly run opens at most two. Anything further waits on the dependency dashboard until a PR is merged or closed, because every one of these PRs costs a hand-written version: commit.

customManagers.description: An appVersion or image tag under a `# renovate:` annotation. The pins live in Chart.yaml appVersion and in values.yaml tag:, which no native manager reads. Further comment lines may sit between the annotation and the key: in values.yaml the annotation has to go above the `# --` line, or helm-docs renders it into the value's description.

packageRules.description: One PR per chart, so a merge releases one chart. influxdb3-core pins two images (server, Explorer); without this they would be two PRs, two releases and two manual version bumps for the same chart.
Grouped per chart for the same reason, and the group name is what the PR title says.
terraform-mcp-server pins the same image in Chart.yaml appVersion and values.yaml tag; both move in one PR.

docker.io/influxdb publishes 3.x only as <version>-core and <version>-enterprise, and still carries 1.x and 2.x tags. Reading the version out of the -core tags is what keeps this chart on InfluxDB 3 Core.
